title: GetOAuth2ResponseObj
description: Response returned when retrieving the OAuth2 configuration for a client. Identical to `EnableOAuth2ResponseObj` except that `oauth2ClientSecret` is **not** returned because the secret is only ever exposed at enablement time.

oauth2ClientId.description: The OAuth2 client identifier issued for this Azupay client.

oauth2TokenUrl.description: The OAuth2 token endpoint to request access tokens from.

oauth2GrantType.description: The OAuth2 grant type supported by this client.

oauth2TtlInSecs.description: The lifetime, in seconds, of access tokens issued for this client.

oauth2AllowedScopes.description: The list of OAuth2 scopes that this client is allowed to request.
